args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring (and FIN-212) requires banker's rounding, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
values such as 2.675 round to 2.68 and 2.665 round to 2.66.

args.body:
The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66) per FIN-212, but src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

Changes:
- Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in `round_money`'s `quantize` call to match the documented behavior and FIN-212.

CI on this branch (run ci-0001) passed.
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

Per policy, merging into main requires code-owner approval, so I've left the PR open for review.
